request: Add two horizontal buttons to the front panel. One above existing one, the other below - all approximately equally distanced. Buttons should be copies of existing one.

actions.operation: Create one button by copying the existing button.

parameters.spacing: approximately equal to the spacing between the existing button and the lower copied button

actions.target: The front panel and the existing button on it.
actions.relational_constraint: Place the copied button above the existing button on the front panel. Its distance from the existing button should be approximately equal to the distance between the existing button and the lower copied button.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the front panel, the existing button to copy, the panel's above/below direction, and an appropriate approximately equal spacing because no numerical distance is specified.
steps: Localize the operator-facing side using part.semantic_orientation: the +Y view is the front with confidence 0.92, and CAD Z is the vertical direction. Therefore, preserve the source button's X and Y placement and interpret above as a translation in the +Z direction.

Use R04, Operator controls and brew-head assembly, as the primary edit section. Identify F013, Auxiliary horizontal indicator slot, represented by SOLID 39, as the existing horizontal button visible to the left of the rotary selector in the +Y and iso1 views. FACE 424 is its exposed front contact face; copy the complete source solid rather than only this face so that all side walls, end rounds, depth, and rear mounting geometry are retained.

Use the operator-facing panel surface as the placement datum. FACE 58 of F002 is the explicitly classified broad +Y-facing support wall associated with the operator-facing panel region; preserve the copied button's existing offset from this support surface and verify that the copy remains seated on the same visible front-panel skin.

Determine the centroid or local placement coordinate system of SOLID 39. Retain its current long axis parallel to CAD X so the copied feature remains horizontal, and retain its protrusion or recess direction parallel to Y.

Define a shared center-to-center vertical pitch d for both new buttons. Because no numerical spacing is specified, choose d from the available panel area so that both future copies remain fully inside the front-panel boundary and clear the upper trim, panel seam, rotary selector F010, control-position markers F011, paired bars F012, and brew-head housing F014.
Create an associative copy or translated instance of the complete F013/SOLID 39 geometry using translation vector (0, 0, +d). Do not scale, rotate, mirror, or redraw the profile.

If the CAD workflow requires reconstruction instead of a body copy, create a sketch on the same panel-support plane as the source, project the complete source-button perimeter from FACE 424, preserve the source slot length, width, end radii, and horizontal X alignment, then extrude or cut to exactly the same depth and direction as F013. Reapply the same edge fillets or blends as the source.
Keep the new upper button aligned with the original button in X and Y. Constrain its center-to-center Z distance from the original to d.
Check that the copied solid does not intersect F010, F011, the enclosure boundary, or trim geometry and that its exposed face has the same outward orientation and appearance as FACE 424.

actions.operation: Create one button by copying the existing button.

parameters.spacing: approximately equal to the spacing between the upper copied button and the existing button

actions.target: The front panel, the existing button, and the upper copied button created by the preceding action.
actions.relational_constraint: Place the copied button below the existing button on the front panel. The upper copied button, existing button, and lower copied button should form an approximately equally spaced above-and-below arrangement.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the front panel, the existing button to copy, the panel's above/below direction, and an appropriate approximately equal spacing because no numerical distance is specified.
steps: Reuse F013/SOLID 39 as the source rather than copying the newly created upper instance, ensuring that both additions are direct, dimensionally identical copies of the original horizontal button.

Reuse the same front-panel datum and local coordinate system established in the preceding action. Based on semantic orientation, below is the -Z direction while X remains the horizontal direction across the front panel.
Reuse the exact shared pitch d selected for the upper copy; do not independently estimate a second distance.

Create an associative copy or translated instance of the complete F013/SOLID 39 geometry using translation vector (0, 0, -d). Preserve the X coordinate, Y mounting depth, horizontal orientation, end radii, exposed FACE 424 form, and all source blends.

If reconstructing parametrically, project the same F013 profile onto the front-panel sketch plane, constrain it horizontally, locate its center at Zsource-d, and apply the same extrusion or cut depth and the same fillet or chamfer treatment as the existing button.

Apply an equal-distance constraint so that the upper-copy-to-original center distance equals the original-to-lower-copy center distance. This produces a three-member vertical arrangement with the original button as the middle member.
Verify that all three buttons are collinear along CAD Z, remain horizontal along CAD X, and have identical dimensions and panel offsets.

Check the lower copy for interference with the lower edge or seam of the control panel, the brew-head assembly F014/F015, and adjacent control hardware. If clearance requires adjustment, modify the single shared pitch d so both upper and lower spacing remain equal rather than moving only one copy.
Regenerate the assembly and confirm in the +Y front view and iso1 view that the result is one original horizontal button with one identical copy above and one identical copy below.
